bio: As spirited as the winds of Brittany (where he grew up), Rodolphe Regnauld harbours a great love for the produce of his adopted region. Here he showcases it in a series of meat and fish dishes: Guilvinec langoustine cooked two ways, raspberries, peas, Sturia caviar from Aquitaine; Rossini fillet of Salers beef served with foie gras from the Limagne plains and a rich gravy....
